verdict: KEEP THE FEATURE, MOVE THE DECLARATION TO 0 (no directional claim)
precedent: docs/efv-2026-07-30 pitcher `age_rel_level`, recorded in efv_model._FEATURES_PIT and data/xfv_sign_merge_gate.json. Same four steps run here; two of the four land DIFFERENTLY and are recorded as such rather than assimilated to the precedent.

step1_suppressor_check.reasoning: efv_sign_audit classifies SUPPRESSOR only when the MARGINAL agrees with the declaration while the partial does not. Here the marginal weighted Pearson is +0.0165, on the SAME side as the fit, so the suppressor defence the pitcher case had (marginal -0.0543) is NOT available. But the marginal is not reliably signed EITHER way: the rank marginal (Spearman) is -0.0547, on the DECLARED side, and the unregularized OLS partial is +0.0119, BELOW the audit's own NOISE_W 0.02 floor. The served ridge +0.0420 is 2.1x that floor and the second-smallest weight in the hitter set. Nothing here supports -1, and nothing supports +1.
step1_suppressor_check.sibling_carries_the_declared_direction: age_rel_level served -0.2159, marginal -0.2146: the age block's negative direction is intact, it just does not live in this column.

step1_stability.reasoning: 6 of 9 informative folds positive, fold-weight mean -0.0056, range -0.2754 to +0.1231. Like the pitcher case there is a drift with sample size (the 5 largest folds, train n 845..1641, are all positive), but unlike it the magnitudes never leave the noise band. This is an UNSTABLE sign, not a stable positive one. The 2014/2015 folds are degenerate (pre-StatsAPI, constant production columns) and are excluded rather than counted as disagreement.

prior_vintage_2026_07_25.note: This is the vintage efv_model and efv_score still quote: served -0.0619, negative in 9 of 9. The sign inverted across one matrix rebuild. A direction that flips when the LABEL is redefined is by definition not a theory-defensible declaration, which is the positive argument for 0 over +1.

step1_resolution_isolation.why: The 2026-07-30 pitcher precedent attributed its flip to the C1 decimal-age ship (2026-07-29). Tested here on the SAME rows by rounding the age column back to integers. It is NOT the cause on the hitter side.
step1_resolution_isolation.conclusion: Rounding away the decimal resolution does NOT restore the declared negative sign, it goes MORE positive (+0.0520, +0.0668 with the sibling also rounded), and the marginal stays positive (+0.0205). The FEATURE COLUMN is not what moved. The MARGINAL correlation of age with realized WAR went from -0.0506 (2026-07-25 ledger, n 1882) to +0.0165 (now, n 1883) on the same pool, which is a LABEL-side change from the 2026-08-04 matrix rebuild, not a feature-side one. Isolating which label change is outside this lane.

step2_collinear_split.verdict: COLLINEAR SPLIT - CONFIRMED (this is where the hitter case DIVERGES from the pitcher precedent)
step2_collinear_split.reasoning: r(age, age_rel_level) = +0.518. Remove the sibling and `age` SNAPS BACK to the declared direction, -0.0502. The sibling barely notices the removal of `age` (-0.2159 -> -0.1952). By _sweep_signs' own rule (`split = contradiction AND the partner-dropped refit no longer contradicts`) this is a COLLINEAR_SPLIT verdict, i.e. one age signal arbitrarily divided between two columns, not an independent conditional effect.
step2_collinear_split.contrast_with_precedent: On pitchers the same test came out the OPPOSITE way and that is what earned that adjudication its 'independent conditional effect' reading: dropping `age` pushed pitcher age_rel_level MORE positive (+0.0418 -> +0.0916), proving the two were not a split. Here it snaps back. So the hitter contradiction is WEAKER evidence for a real positive effect than the pitcher one was, which again argues 0 and not +1.
step2_collinear_split.merge_remedy: Already adjudicated 2026-07-25, data/xfv_sign_merge_gate.json key 'hit:age+age_rel_level': merging the pair into one z-mean column is itself a null (+0.00033 = 0.02x the 0.017 floor, CI95 [-0.0256, +0.0121], p_merge_helps 0.374). Not re-run; a merge that was the smallest effect in the whole 07-25 set is not a remedy, and shipping one would move served numbers, which a correctness fix must not.

step3_drop_gate.protocol: The pit-`age` protocol, fresh on the 2026-08-04 matrix: 11 forward-chained splits (train = decision_year < Y), the shipped blend leg at lambda 0.70 with the consensus OLS anchor refit on the same train rows, paired bootstrap B=2000 resampling TRAIN AND TEST with a refit per draw, a zero-information control (the same column row-permuted and KEPT in the set), and a permutation null band (1000 draws, labels shuffled within fold).
step3_drop_gate.reading: Dropping HELPS by +0.00669 = 0.393x the 0.017 hitter MDE95. That is sub-floor and it is not resolvable: the bootstrap CI95 straddles zero, and the zero-information control scores +0.0062, which is 93% of the candidate's +0.00669. Destroying the column's information while leaving it in the model buys almost exactly what removing it buys, so the 'gain' is not a gain from removing information. Permutation null p 0.150. Dropping helps in only 6 of 11 folds and the fold deltas are dominated by 2018 (+0.0601) with the other ten inside +/-0.012.
step3_drop_gate.decision_rule: EFV_GATE_STANDARD section 6: 'Do not add and do not remove features on sub-floor evidence.' 0.393x floor with a CI straddling zero is sub-floor. THE FEATURE STAYS.

step4_declaration.why_not_minus_1: The served ridge fits +0.0420 against it. That is the RED.
step4_declaration.why_not_plus_1: +1 would require a stable, theory-defensible 'older hitters are better'. Every stability probe refuses it: 6 of 9 folds positive with a NEGATIVE fold mean (-0.0056), rank marginal -0.0547, OLS partial +0.0119 below the noise floor, the sign inverts to -0.0502 the moment the collinear sibling is removed, and it was -0.0619 and negative in 9 of 9 folds one matrix rebuild ago.
step4_declaration.why_0: 0 is 'no directional claim' and is a legal LightGBM constraint. It is the declaration this codebase has used five times for exactly this situation (hit k_rel / n_milb_seasons / milb_missing 2026-07-25, pit age 2026-07-25, pit age_rel_level 2026-07-30). It stops the module asserting a direction its own fit contradicts without asserting the reverse.
step4_declaration.served_impact: NONE. The declaration is consumed only by efv_model._fit_lgbm_mono's monotone_constraints, which binds the eval-only LightGBM challenger. The shipped ridge (fit_production_stack -> prospect_path._fit_ridge) ignores it. No grade, WAR, surplus or ordering moves.
